name: ShapeNetCore: 3D CAD Model Taxonomy Subset
description: ShapeNetCore is a densely annotated, clean subset of the full ShapeNet 3D CAD repository covering 55 common object categories with approximately 51,300 unique 3D models. Each model features single clean 3D meshes, standardized alignments, and WordNet synset taxonomy mappings.

license.name: ShapeNet Terms of Use

source_references.title: ShapeNet: An Information-Rich 3D Model Repository
source_references.notes: Foundational technical report detailing ShapeNetCore taxonomy and alignment.

verification.notes: Verified against arXiv:1512.03012 and official ShapeNet portal documentation.

size.notes: Wavefront OBJ 3D meshes with materials, textures, and voxel grids.
